nodes.label: Host-Authoritative Combat System
nodes.rationale: Evaluates weapon logic on the Host in a 20Hz Fixed Physics Tick, ensuring hitscans (raycasts) and projectiles strike exactly where enemies are physically located.

nodes.label: Hitscan and Melee Logic
nodes.rationale: Gauss rifle uses world.castRay. Melee weapons use front-facing cleave AoE sweeps to easily strike small entities like Muck Pigs.

nodes.label: Projectile Physics & Syncing
nodes.rationale: Spawns Rapier RigidBody projectiles. Broadcasts SPAWN_PROJECTILE for visual tracer rendering. Projectiles are GC-ed after 5 seconds.

nodes.label: Centralized Swarm Manager
nodes.rationale: Processes AI pathfinding and target acquisition on the Host. Spawns mobs adaptively over procedural valleys/hills.

nodes.label: Grapple Gun Tethering
nodes.rationale: Tether.jsx renders dynamic instanced cylinders stretching from the player barrel to anchor, while the physics controller applies forces.
